expected_diagnostics.name: cursor-frontmatter-missing
expected_diagnostics.suggestion: open the file with a first line containing exactly '---'

expected_diagnostics.name: cursor-frontmatter-invalid
expected_diagnostics.suggestion: set 'description' to a string, or remove the field

expected_diagnostics.name: cursor-frontmatter-invalid
expected_diagnostics.suggestion: quote the pattern so it is valid YAML, e.g. globs: "*.ts"

expected_diagnostics.name: cursor-glob-invalid
expected_diagnostics.suggestion: set 'globs' to one glob string or a list of glob strings

expected_diagnostics.name: cursor-field-unknown
expected_diagnostics.suggestion: remove 'unknown' or use one of: description, globs, alwaysApply

expected_diagnostics.name: cursor-always-invalid
expected_diagnostics.suggestion: set 'alwaysApply' to unquoted true or false
